name: Sign-up
description: Creates a free AquaStream account in minutes using name, email, and password, or sign up with Google or Facebook.

name: Login
description: Securely logs owners in to their station's account and pick up right where they left off.

name: Dashboard
description: Displays the station's total, pending, and completed orders at a glance, and a list of urgent orders that need delivery that day.

name: Create Order
description: Logs a new order through a simple form that captures the customer's name, address, quantity of gallons, delivery date, and payment method.

name: Orders List
description: Displays all ongoing orders in a live list, where owners can delete or update the details of any order at any time.

name: Daily Sales
description: Shows the station's daily total revenue, average sales, and order count.

name: Weekly Sales
description: Tracks order volume and revenue trends across weeks to help owners monitor growth over time.

name: History
description: Stores every completed order so owners can look back at past deliveries.
